name: D.W. Griffith

films.title: Broken Blossoms or The Yellow Man and the Girl
films.overview: A frail waif, abused by her brutal boxer father in London's seedy Limehouse District, is befriended by a sensitive Chinese immigrant with tragic consequences.

films.title: Intolerance: Love's Struggle Throughout the Ages
films.overview: The story of a poor young woman, separated by prejudice from her husband and baby, is interwoven with tales of intolerance from throughout history.

films.title: Way Down East
films.overview: A naïve country girl is tricked into a sham marriage by a wealthy womanizer, then must rebuild her life despite the taint of having borne a child out of wedlock.

films.title: True Heart Susie
films.overview: In a country town, Susie, innocent and big-hearted, quietly gives money to William Jenkins, a man she secretly yearns for, so he can attend college. After he graduates, he returns and becomes the town's minister. However, he never realizes how Susie feels about him and ignores her in favor of Bettina Hopkins, a wild and unfaithful girl who steals his heart. Susie must then find a way to show William that she's loved him all along.

films.title: Orphans of the Storm
films.overview: France, on the eve of the French Revolution. Henriette and Louise have been raised together as sisters. When the plague that takes their parents' lives causes Louise's blindness, they decide to travel to Paris in search of a cure, but they separate when a lustful aristocrat crosses their path.

films.title: The Musketeers of Pig Alley
films.overview: A man recognizes the thief who had previously robbed him as one of the men involved in an unrelated mob shootout.

films.title: A Corner in Wheat
films.overview: On a whim, a greedy tycoon decides to corner the world market in wheat. This doubles the price of bread, forcing grain producers into charity lines and others further into poverty. The film contrasts the differences between the lives of those who work to grow the wheat and the life of the man who dabbles in its sale for profit.

films.title: The Lonedale Operator
films.overview: A young woman takes over her sick father's role as telegraph operator at a railway station, and has to deal with a team intent on train robbery.

films.title: The Lonely Villa
films.overview: A gang of thieves lure a man out of his home so that they can rob it and threaten his wife and children. The family barricade themselves in an interior room, but the criminals are well-equipped for breaking in. When the father finds out what is happening, he must race against time to get back home.

films.title: Those Awful Hats
films.overview: A pair of young ladies cause trouble at the cinema with their lavish hats.

films.title: The Birth of a Nation
films.overview: Two families, abolitionist Northerners the Stonemans and Southern landowners the Camerons, intertwine. When Confederate colonel Ben Cameron is captured in battle, nurse Elsie Stoneman petitions for his pardon. In Reconstruction-era South Carolina, Cameron founds the Ku Klux Klan, battling Elsie's congressman father and his African-American protégé, Silas Lynch.

known_for: Intolerance: Love's Struggle Throughout the Ages
